qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unrivaled global brewing scale and dominant #1 volume share in key profit pools (Latin America, US, Africa). Pricing power demonstrated through consistent positive price/mix, though challenged by brand erosion in US Bud Light.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 5 (Management Score = 0, REJECT). Disastrous capital allocation legacy from the $103B debt-fueled SABMiller acquisition in 2016 which impaired shareholder returns for a decade, forced multiple dividend cuts, and left an unwieldy debt burden ($67B+ net debt). Further exacerbated by the 2023 Bud Light marketing misstep that permanently forfeited #1 US market share.
qualitative.evidence: Net debt of $67.6B (~2.9x EBITDA, >12x net income) remains elevated 8+ years post-SABMiller. 5-year GAAP ROIC depressed at 7-9%. In 2023, Bud Light lost over 25% of its sales volume in the US following marketing backlash, ceding the #1 US beer title to Constellation's Modelo Especial. Non-GAAP normalized adjustments routinely mask underlying equity stagnation.
